name: cards
description: Twenty-one: every move a player makes. The action says which: start a game (shuffling a deck only flows can see), join one, draw a card, or stand.

nodes.message: action must be new-game, join, draw or stand

nodes.data: { status: "waiting", players: [{ id: identity.id, name: input.name, cards: [], total: 0, state: "playing" }], turn: 0, deckId: steps.shuffled.id, winnerId: null }

nodes.merge: { players: steps.join_game.data.players + [{ id: identity.id, name: input.name, cards: [], total: 0, state: "playing" }], status: "playing" }

nodes.value: map(steps.draw_game.data.players, p => p.id == identity.id ? drawn(p, steps.card) : p)

nodes.merge: { players: steps.with_card, turn: steps.me.state == "bust" ? steps.draw_game.data.turn + 1 : steps.draw_game.data.turn, status: steps.draw_over ? "finished" : "playing", winnerId: steps.draw_over ? winner(steps.with_card) : null }

nodes.body: { card: steps.card, total: steps.me.total, bust: steps.me.state == "bust" }

nodes.value: map(steps.stand_game.data.players, p => p.id == identity.id ? stood(p) : p)

nodes.merge: { players: steps.standing, turn: steps.stand_game.data.turn + 1, status: steps.stand_over ? "finished" : "playing", winnerId: steps.stand_over ? winner(steps.standing) : null }
